response.sql: WITH film_copies AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id), ranked AS (SELECT film_id, copies, SUM(copies) OVER () AS total_copies, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY copies DESC) AS copy_rank FROM film_copies) SELECT film_id, copies, copies / total_copies AS share FROM ranked WHERE copy_rank <= 10 ORDER BY copies DESC, film_id;
